text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a tighter set of battlecards comparing Redwood vs cloud AI platforms, LLM API providers, and inference infra vendors. Goal: ship to sales + webinar collateral by next Wed.
Jordan: +1. What are the top differentiators we want to highlight? I'm thinking latency/cost controls, unified runtime, private deployment options, and rollout/observability.
Leo: For growth, we need 2–3 TL;DR bullets per competitor: headline claim, typical customer objection, and 1-line rebuttal. Keep it skimmable for SDRs.
Priya: Sales asks: objection-handling snippets. Example: 'Why not just use managed endpoints from a cloud provider?' -> 'You can, but teams see predictable unit economics + rollout controls + private deployment that cloud endpoints alone don't offer.' Add a short metric if we can.
Dan: I can pull the latest benchmarks. Quick note: Dedicated batching gives ~30–40% lower cost for long-context gen vs vanilla cloud endpoints in our Jan tests. I'll attach numbers.
bench-bot: Benchmark report uploaded: <https://redwood.internal/benchmarks/2026-q1.csv> 
Maya: Great. Leo — can you draft three one-liners for each competitor bucket (clouds, LLM APIs, infra vendors) and drop them into the battlecard doc? Make them copy-paste-ready.
Leo: On it. Also proposing two webinar hooks: 'Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency' (business audience) and 'Building reliable user-facing LLM features at scale' (technical audience).
Priya: Routing recommendation for inbound leads: tag by competitor mention (competitor:cloud, competitor:llm-api, competitor:infra). High-intent (pricing/POC asks) -> AE; mid-intent (benchmarks/request for materials) -> SDR nurture sequence with battlecard link.
Jordan: Messaging guardrails: public-facing blog should avoid direct vendor callouts; internal battlecards can be explicit and include competitor feature parity. Include a migration checklist and compatibility matrix.
Maya: Love the guardrails. Priorities for the battlecard landing page: 1) Top 5 rebuttals, 2) Snapshot benchmark snippets (one-liners + link to CSV), 3) Customer proof points, 4) Quick migration playbook.
Dan: I'll add two customer quotes mapped to the 'cost' and 'reliability' plays. Also attaching the raw numbers and test configs.
Leo: I'll draft a 15-minute webinar script (sales-facing) and a 45-minute technical deep-dive outline (SE + product). Will include proposed slides and live demo plan.
Priya: Need a short SDR FAQ: pricing model differences, typical TTM for Private deployment, SOC/ISO compliance status, and who to loop in for technical deep dives.
Maya: Owners: Leo -> battlecard copy + webinar hooks; Dan -> benchmarks + quotes; Jordan -> product comparison table + migration checklist; Priya -> inbound routing + SDR FAQ and slides. Deadline: beta battlecard to sales by Monday EOD, webinar first draft by Thursday.
Priya: I can own the sales deck slides and coordinate SE review for technical claims.
Jordan: I'll update the comparison matrix and ping @Maya once done.
Maya: Thanks all — please @mention me on the doc when you drop things. If any blocker, call it out here early. :thumbsup:
